author: Crazy_Gurl
body:
Hi there,
I am appealing for a ban because yesterday I was banned from the Avicus server while playing Nebula for Anti Knock-back / Force Field. I have no idea why he thought I was hacking because trust me I hate it when people hack and I use no hacking clients what so ever. I am very disappointed because I have just bought a brand computer and a very fast clicking gaming mouse. Both of these items cost heaps and now to be banned on my favorite server I fell like I have wasted all my money and as I am only earning pocket money this took me ages to save up.

Hope you can do something about this,
                                                              Thanks again Crazy_gurl

title: Banned for Force Field

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
Hello Crazy_Gurl,

You have since been caught ban evading and therefore this appeal is automatically denied. 

Regards,

Posigndun - Avicus Network Senior Moderator
